snippet.title: YAMIGATARI: FOR3ST Trailer
snippet.description:
Game details: https://www.eastasiasoft.com/games/YAMIGATARI-FOR3ST

On the third night of a camping trip, a girl named Nora is haunted by a terrifyingly real dream that beckons her into the darkness. After that, the peaceful outing takes a nightmarish turn. Pursued by a woman’s voice and an inhuman creature lurking near her camp, Nora must find a way to escape the forest before the darkness claims her!

YAMIGATARI: FOR3ST is a horror-themed side-scrolling adventure presented in a mix of old-school pixel art and hand-drawn character portraits, a tale of survival and mystery where you must use your wits and nerves to find a path forward. Guide Nora through the forest, investigate graves, shrines, a locked tunnel, a well and more unnerving fixtures of the darkened woods to find clues. Solve puzzles, locate the combinations to locks, read notes and pick up key items needed to progress.

Can you help Nora escape, or will you lead her straight to a wicked demise in this lonely wilderness?
